policy: Entries describe upstream projects and the evidence Forge has for them. A URL is not a compatibility claim, and a detected local file is not a verified version. Runtime behaviour remains unproven until tested.

entries.name: SKSE64
entries.version_scope: 1.5.97 through current 1.6.x (select the build matching the executable)
entries.provenance: official upstream repository; local loader probe
entries.demo: loads a DLL only when its SKSEPlugin_Version/Address Library contract matches the running executable
entries.limitations: Version compatibility is per executable. A successful compile is not load proof.

entries.name: CommonLibSSE-NG
entries.limitations: The API signatures are tied to the pinned commit. Newer upstream revisions are not adopted without a representative build.

entries.name: Papyrus compiler and sources
entries.version_scope: installed Creation Kit compiler and matching .psc imports
entries.provenance: configured local tool and Papyrus import roots
entries.limitations: The installed compiler accepts syntax; it does not prove runtime behaviour or API availability in the running game.

entries.name: Creation Kit
entries.limitations: No universal headless bridge is bundled; UI automation is narrow and requires review.

entries.name: SkyUI
entries.limitations: Menus are game-version specific and require in-game layout testing.

entries.name: MCM Helper
entries.limitations: SKI_ConfigBase is legacy; MCM Helper is the current route. Menu behaviour needs a save/reload test.

entries.name: Spell Perk Item Distributor
entries.limitations: Only the modeled grammar subset is validated. Runtime distribution needs a log/load-order test.

entries.name: Keyword Item Distributor
entries.limitations: Only the modeled grammar subset is validated; keyword/form coverage needs runtime evidence.

entries.name: Base Object Swapper
entries.limitations: Only the modeled grammar subset is validated; object/reference resolution needs runtime evidence.

entries.name: SkyPatcher
entries.limitations: Unknown properties are reported as unverified, never invented or rewritten.

entries.name: Open Animation Replacer
entries.limitations: Animation selection needs in-game visual review; behavior graph generation is a separate toolchain.

entries.name: houseCARL
entries.limitations: Forge does not bundle it; live record work requires the pinned installation and record-level verification.

entries.name: Mutagen
entries.version_scope: version selected by the patcher project
entries.limitations: Typed access still requires master/index validation and semantic round-trip checks.

entries.name: Synthesis
entries.limitations: The GUI executable is not accepted as the CLI. Patcher output requires load-order comparison.

entries.name: xEdit / SSEEdit
entries.limitations: Scripted automation needs an allowlisted Pascal script and completion markers; GUI inspection is not a headless proof.

entries.name: LOOT
entries.limitations: Forge validates typed plans and does not invent unsupported GUI arguments.

entries.name: NifSkope
entries.limitations: Forge does not bundle NIF editing. Structural inspection is not visual or collision proof.

entries.name: DirectXTex / texconv
entries.limitations: Format conversion is not an art-direction or quality decision; alpha and normal-map semantics must be preserved.

entries.name: Pandora Behaviour Engine+
entries.limitations: Behavior generation is animation/tool-version specific and needs in-game review.

entries.name: DynDOLOD / xLODGen / TexGen
entries.provenance: upstream project and Forge worker contract
entries.limitations: Generation is load-order and worldspace specific; visual and performance verification remain mandatory.

entries.name: Papyrus Profiler
entries.limitations: No profiler is bundled. Forge can ingest exported evidence but cannot invent script timings.

entries.name: PresentMon
entries.limitations: PresentMon capture is external and must use comparable scene, settings and hardware metadata.

entries.name: Community Shaders
entries.limitations: Shader effects and compatibility are GPU/driver and game-version specific; no performance claim without comparable captures.
